verdicts.reason: Both use the same broken layout. The headline panel and the thin yellow frame sit on the left, with the bottom half of the frame left empty. The photo is cut off from them as a small inset on the right. Stray yellow tick marks float in white space and on the photo's edge, and a yellow bar is cropped at the top. The original's layered headline-over-photo design is lost. B's photo is slightly larger but sits closer to the right edge, so neither one is meaningfully better.
